questions.question:
A # B means 'A is the brother of B'.

A @ B means 'A is the son of B'.

A & B means 'A is the father of B'.

A % B means 'A is the mother of B'.

If W # Q @ T & Y @ M % K % L, then how is K related to W?
questions.solution:
The symbols and their meanings in the family tree are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5be43c029e3b24aad04116d10d13a6c0598924f3d9b575ade6931a1002cd428d.png] 

According to the given statements, we will get,

W # Q @ T & Y @ M % K % L 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/14b308405b868098a956451d25092bc0a2fd655bfeb821fb639ba504f93baba1.png] 

Thus, K is **sister** to W.

Hence, the correct answer is '__**option 1**__'.

questions.question: If A - B means that A is the father of B, A + B means that A is the mother of B, A × B means that A is the brother of B then which of the following expression shows that Q is the brother of P?
questions.solution:
The symbols and their meanings in the family tree are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c74c3fc18ae32322dfce40504ba78d4638a08e810525a49f9bbfc57971f0d3dc.png] 

Given statements and their meaning are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1e9bb00cb7b0a38f6a2217d04cef52ba9205c733dd3433669ff059dc545b4cd0.png] 

 

According to the given statement the family tree will be:

1) P × Q - R

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c49df0feffa2253d974ab3e7651e24e1417f849720f66c96eaf090b65c99afa8.png] 

__
 
• Therefore,** Q is the brother of P.**

2) P × Q + R

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0184899d6a8ca5c36544bb8c956834ae9966bb99cede5e49c56fe6cf04b9ef53.png] 

 
• Therefore, Q is the sister of P.

3) R + P × Q

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6b078f95279b068909c339b28fb25f86baf48c1bad6005577e102abfaf033e43.png] 

 
• Therefore, Q is the brother/sister of P.

4) Q - P - R

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/17b17f7bfb6a119fba4f933c57305525ac8e8a8c9fed518250b65b15e22252bf.png] 

 
• Therefore, Q is the father of P.

Thus, the expression **P × Q - R** shows that Q is the brother of P.

Hence, the correct answer is '**option 1**__'.

questions.question:
By interchanging the given two signs which of the following equation will be not correct?

+ and ÷
questions.solution:
BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d50192f098c21078501d30eeafe1a8c64bc30dd9621c48caa8a39ffc60f68b64.png] 

Lets check all the options 

1) 12 ÷ 8 × 12 + 6 - 7 = 21

After intechanging the signs + and ÷ , we will get,

⇒ 12 + 8 × __**12 ÷ 6**__ - 7 = 21

Applying Bodmas rule, we will get,

⇒ 12 + __**8 × **____2__ - 7 = 21

⇒ __**12 + **____**16__**__** - 7**__ = 21

⇒ 21 = 21

 

2) 9 - 3 + 12 × 8 ÷ 4 = 11

After intechanging the signs + and ÷ , we will get,

⇒ 9 - __**3 ÷ 12**__ × 8 + 4 = 11

Applying Bodmas rule, we will get,

⇒ 9 - __**0.25**____** × 8**__ + 4 = 11

⇒ __**9 - 2**____** + 4**__ = 11

⇒ 11 = 11

 

3) 46 + 23 ÷ 14 × 5 - 6 = 66

After intechanging the signs + and ÷ , we will get,

⇒ __**46 ÷ 23**__ + 14 × 5 - 6 = 66

Applying Bodmas rule, we will get,

⇒ 2 + __**14 × 5**__ - 6 = 66

⇒ __**2 + 70**____** - 6**__ = 66

⇒ 66 = 66

 

4) 6 + 20 ÷ 12 × 7 - 11 = 70

After intechanging the signs + and ÷ , we will get,

⇒ __**6 ÷ 20**__ + 12 × 7 - 11 = 70

Applying Bodmas rule, we will get,

⇒ 0.3 + __**12 × 7**__ - 11 = 70

⇒ __**0.3 + 84**____** - 11**__ = 70

⇒ 73.3 = 70, is not true

Thus, the equation **6 + 20 ÷ 12 × 7 - 11 = 70** is not correct.

Hence, the correct answer is '__**option 4**__'.

questions.question:
By Interchanging the given two numbers which of the following equation will be correct?

5 and 8
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f22f57d0cf5c493280a0ab6b7dbaea9e3fc5b035c6d410d59c2f476043bd03a8.png] 

1). 5 × 2 - 8 + 9 ÷ 1 = 20

By using BODMAS rule and interchanging given numbers 5 and 8 we get,

8 × 2 - 5 + **9 ÷ 1** = 20

**8**** × 2 **- 5 + 9 = 20

**16 - 5 + 9 **= 20

20 = 20

2). 8 + 5 × 4 - 9 ÷ 3 = 30

By using BODMAS rule and interchanging given numbers 5 and 8 we get,

5 + 8 × 4 - **9 ÷ 3** = 30

5 + **8**** × 4** - 3 = 30

**5 + 32 - 3 **= 30

34 ≠ 30

3). 5 × 7 + 8 - 3 ÷ 1 = 55

By using BODMAS rule and interchanging given numbers 5 and 8 we get,

8 × 7 + 5 - **3 ÷ 1** = 55

**8 × 7** + 5 - 3 = 55

**56 + 5 - 3 **= 55

58 ≠ 55

4). 8 - 5 × 2 + 6 ÷ 2 = -9

By using BODMAS rule and interchanging given numbers 5 and 8 we get,

5 - 8 × 2 + **6 ÷ 2 **= -9

5 - **8**** × 2** + 3 = -9

**5 - 16 + 3 **= -9

-8 = -9

Hence, the** correct answer** is** "Option 1".**

questions.question: In a certain code language, health is wealth' is coded as '626', 'exercise regularly' is coded as '89' and 'bring good food' is coded as '544'. How will 'balanced diet is key' be coded in that language?
questions.solution:
**Logic : It is according to number of letters in a word.**

health is wealth' is coded as '626' (health has 6 letters, is has 2 letters and wealth has 6 letters.)

'exercise regularly' is coded as '89'(exercise has 8 letters, regularly has 9 letters)

'bring good food' is coded as '544'(bring has 5 letters, good has 4 letters and food has 4 letters)

Similarly,

**balanced diet is key coded as '8423'(balanced has 8 letters, diet has 4 letters, is has 2 letters and key has 3 letters)**

Hence, the **correct answer** is** 'Option 1'.**

questions.question:
If '+' means '÷', '-' means '+', '×' means '-' and '÷' means '×', what will be the value of the following expression?

[{(34 × 12) - (4 ÷ 3)} + (12 - 5)] ÷ 5
questions.solution:
BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e2fca224310f491c5c3c1603717179c21bbabf01a207f1269aac3e75867e1f61.png] 

Given: [{(34 × 12) - (4 ÷ 3)} + (12 - 5)] ÷ 5

Apply the sign changes we will get

= [{(34 - 12) + __**(4 × 3)**__} ÷ (12 + 5)] × 5

Apply the BODMAS rule we will get

= [{__**(34 - 12)**__ + 12} ÷ __**(12 + 5)**__] × 5

= [__**{22 + 12**____**}**__ ÷ 17] × 5

= __**[34**____** ÷**____** 17]**__ × 5

= __**2**____** × 5**__

= 10

Thus, the value of the following expression is **10**.

Hence, the correct answer is '__**option 1**__'.
